title: Recommendations for Selection of Diamond and Cubic Boron Nitride Grinding Wheels
clause_1_scope: This standard covers general recommendations and guidelines for the selection of diamond and ubic boron nitride ( CBN ) grinding wheels.
clause_3_terminology: Recommendations for Selection of Diamond and Cubic Boron Nitride Grinding Wheels

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
